name: Cyprus Dominoes
description: Cyprus Dominoes is a regional western-domino connecting game associated with Cypriot table tradition, played by matching open ends and managing hand exit routes across a hand sequence.

overview.description: Cyprus Dominoes is a regional western-domino connecting game associated with Cypriot table tradition, played by matching open ends and managing hand exit routes across a hand sequence.

history.origins: The game is treated as a regional domino ruleset associated with Cyprus, using standard matching play on an expanded set to support longer layouts.
timeline: Modern era: maintained as a regional domino table tradition and documented in rules references.
history.cultural: Represents regional domino play culture emphasizing social competition and hand management.
history.evolution: Expanded-set usage distinguishes it from smaller-set line games in some tables.

setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
setup.equipment: Domino set and table space; optional score tracking.

rules.objective: Be first to empty your hand, or minimize remaining pips if the hand blocks.
rules.gameplay: Players place legal matching tiles to open ends of the layout. If blocked, the active profile determines whether to draw or pass. The hand ends when a player goes out or all players are blocked.
keyRules: Tiles must match legal open ends.
One legal tile is placed per normal turn.
Blocked turns resolve via the table's draw-or-pass profile.
Hand ends on first-out or full block resolution.

strategy.basic: Keep coverage of common end values so you are rarely forced into blocked turns.
strategy.intermediate: Track which pip values are scarce to avoid committing into dead ends.
strategy.advanced: Control end values to constrain opponents while preserving your own safe lines.
tips: Avoid spending your only connector for a common end value too early.
When ahead, prefer safe exits over risky end shaping.

synthesis.shortDescription: Cyprus Dominoes is a Cypriot regional domino connecting game on a double-9 set, focused on matching play and hand management.
